basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and fantasy enthusiast hailing from the misty coasts of Oregon. I spend most of my free time exploring RPGs and card games, both digitally and on tabletop. By day, I work as a software developer, which fuels my passion for technology and intricate game mechanics. I am currently in a long-term relationship with my high school sweetheart. My online hours typically stretch into the late night, often between 9 PM and 3 AM PST. I dislike negativity and toxic behavior on gaming forums, striving to foster a positive community wherever I participate.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of coding experience, I've honed my skills in software development. My interest in games has led me to self-study game design and mechanics through online courses and community exchanges. I frequently contribute to discussions on game strategy and mechanics, particularly in RPG and card game communities.
